summary: This Form 6-K by Elemental Royalty Corp announces Mexican antitrust (CNA) clearance for its pending acquisition of Vizsla Royalties Corp. The registrant, as acquirer, reports this regulatory milestone but provides no new deal terms, price, premium, or board recommendation — details are referenced to the May 13, 2026, arrangement agreement and circular. No definitive agreement is amended; closing is expected shortly subject to conditions. The event is a routine regulatory update without substantive transaction economics or change in probability; thus it is not a special-situation filing under the criteria.
